Ready for the party of a lifetime? Step aboard our luxurious Yacht Tour in Miami Beach and celebrate like never before. This VIP experience is designed for fun, style, and unforgettable memories with your group.

Adventure Highlights
• Biscayne Bay Cruise: Discover iconic Miami scenery from the water
• Millionaire’s Bunker: Cruise past the waterfront homes of celebrities like Jeff Bezos, Ivanka Trump, and Tom Brady
• Marine Life: Spot dolphins, turtles, and manatees along the way
• Sandbar, Snorkeling & Island Stop: Anchor in shallow, warm waters to swim, snorkel, or simply unwind

Onboard Experience
• Bluetooth sound system — be your own DJ
• Water, ice & cooler included
• Bring your own food, drinks & decorations
• Amenities: fridge, floating mat, bathroom & bedroom
